This role can be based in Newport Beach, CA, Omaha, NE, or another approved Pacific Life office location. As Institutional Marketing Strategy Director, you will serve as a strategic marketing partner to IRSG leadership, helping translate business strategy, market dynamics, customer needs, and competitive intelligence into clear marketing priorities and differentiated market strategies. The role spans Pacific Life's institutional retirement businesses, including Pension Risk Transfer (PRT), Defined Contribution Lifetime Income (DCLI), Stable Value, and emerging retirement solutions. Partner with senior business and functional leaders to identify the markets, audiences, opportunities, and priorities where marketing can have the greatest impact. Monitor market, business, and competitive developments and recommend strategic adjustments as priorities and opportunities evolve. Lead ongoing marketing planning and prioritization, establishing clear trade-offs and aligning marketing resources, investments, and activity to the highest-value business priorities and measurable growth objectives. Drive Market Intelligence and Competitive Insights Serve as a strategic consumer of market, customer, and competitive intelligence, bringing relevant insights into IRSG marketing and business discussions. Partner with internal strategy, analytics, research, product, distribution, and other teams to identify and leverage available market and customer insights. Monitor key industry, competitor, regulatory, and market developments and assess their implications for IRSG marketing priorities and business objectives. Identify gaps in market or customer understanding and help define the research or analysis needed to inform strategic decisions. Translate complex market and competitive information into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for business and marketing leaders. Partner with business leaders and subject matter experts to identify priority topics and opportunities where thought leadership can support market engagement and business goals. Translate business priorities and market developments into recommendations for thought leadership themes, audiences, channels, and timing. Partner with operations, digital and other marketing resources to ensure thought leadership initiatives are strategically focused and effectively executed. Advise on executive visibility, industry engagement, conferences, speaking opportunities, and other external opportunities based on business and marketing priorities. Evaluate the effectiveness and relevance of thought leadership efforts and recommend adjustments as business priorities and market dynamics evolve. Inform Go-to-Market and Growth Initiatives Provide strategic marketing leadership for new products, market expansion efforts, strategic initiatives, and emerging growth opportunities. Assess market readiness, audience needs, competitive dynamics, and differentiation opportunities to inform go-to-market strategies. Partner with product, distribution, communications, analytics, digital, and other marketing teams to translate strategy into execution. Help define target audiences, market priorities, value propositions, and channel strategies for priority initiatives. Provide strategic marketing counsel on business cases, executive presentations, strategic communications, and other high-priority business materials. Identify opportunities to strengthen the connection between marketing activity and the customer and distribution journeys that influence growth. Measure Impact and Evolve the Strategy Establish frameworks for evaluating marketing effectiveness, market impact, and progress against strategic priorities. Define meaningful KPIs for marketing strategies, thought leadership initiatives, market engagement, and priority growth programs. Use data, analytics, research, and business results to evaluate what is working and where strategy should evolve. Regularly assess the effectiveness of marketing investments and recommend changes in priorities, resources, or approach. Champion a culture of accountability, learning, and continuous improvement across institutional marketing. Demonstrated experience developing marketing strategies that are directly connected to business growth and strategic priorities. Strong understanding of institutional financial services, retirement markets, insurance, investments, asset management, or related B2B financial markets. Experience translating market, customer, competitive, and business intelligence into strategic recommendations. Proven ability to influence senior leaders and build alignment across complex, matrixed organizations. Experience developing positioning, segmentation, value propositions, messaging, go-to-market strategies, or related strategic marketing frameworks. Exceptional communication, presentation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to make complex subjects clear and compelling. Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to move from insight to recommendation to action. Demonstrated ability to operate strategically while working effectively with teams responsible for execution. Experience working with institutional buyers and influencers, including consultants, intermediaries, advisors, plan sponsors, institutional investors, recordkeepers, or retirement-focused organizations. Experience building or leading market intelligence, competitive intelligence, customer insight, or strategic planning capabilities. About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role:
Multi-Agent systems are becoming an increasingly important part of how AI is deployed, whether via fast small-model subagents inside a product, or
large groups of agents

. Training Claude to be maximally effective and safe within large groups is a challenging new area of reinforcement learning, and represents a new axis for scaling test time compute.
We are looking for researchers who have experience training multi-agent systems at the largest scale and an appreciation for the incentives and mechanism design that come into play.
Responsibilities:
Help create and optimize environments and data for model training that maximize Claude’s performance or ease of use on agentic tasks
Ideate, develop, and compare the performance of different agent harness configurations (eg memory, context management, communication architectures for agents)

Work with our product org to find solutions to our most vexing challenges in applying agents to our products

Have experience with large-scale RL on language models
Have experience training multi-agent systems
Enjoy going deeply into the roots of a problem and understanding its foundations, rather than its surface.
Have good communication skills and an interest in working with other researchers on difficult tasks
Have a passion for making powerful technology safe and societally beneficial
Are excited for a mission-driven org with fast-paced, impactful work
Representative projects:
Design and build reinforcement learning environments to train groups of Claudes how to solve problems together efficiently
Design and build agent affordances that unlock new capabilities and scales of agents, while keeping the Bitter Lesson in mind

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

반환 정책
본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (
recruitingops@coupang.com
) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.
